properties.description: Four handler tests pinning that the loop_status reply carries the lens: the silent case names who could be asked; the recorded case names them; the lens names `next` as the agent's to-do list; the lens never withholds `next`. Written first and observed failing (0 passed, 4 failed) before the fix in coherence.rs, from the 2026-09-14 field report where a loop_status reply was read out to a person verbatim.
properties.name: a_loop_status_reply_says_whose_words_to_use.rs
